summary: The Stirling and second-order digamma results are new: neither Mathlib nor TauCeti has a Stirling formula for Gamma. The PR does re-prove an existing public lemma (`TauCeti.one_sub_cos_pos`), proves the same slit-plane step twice, and adds a thin private wrapper around the new public digamma bound.
